name: Liena☆Crystal
source:
Europe, 1895. Lina and her friend Pes were on the way back home from the spring festival when a strong light hit both of them. Pes became a dog while Lina became a futanari. Shall they succeed in getting back to original form?

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1895年的欧洲。莉娜和朋友佩斯从春祭返家途中，被一道强光同时照中。佩斯变成了狗，莉娜则变成了扶她。两人能够恢复原样吗？

[根据[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]修改]
